original_claim: historically measured stems were excluded by exact (domain, stem) identity
defect: historical ledgers store suffix stems, whereas the frozen source view uses domain-prefixed stems
scientific_consequence: The first 20-image/domain split remains discovery evidence and is not independent of historical image identities. The 24-image/domain and 16-image/domain held-out splits use canonical stem exclusion and have zero historical overlap; both reproduce the complete 15-cell phase map.
